name: firecrawl-api
description: Firecrawl is an open-source web crawling and scraping API that converts websites into clean, LLM-ready data. This container provides the Firecrawl API and connects to the Firecrawl Playwright, Redis, RabbitMQ and NuQ PostgreSQL services on the firecrawl Docker network. Configuration Port 3002 Firecrawl API HTTP port. This port is exposed on the host for access to the Firecrawl API. Redis Uses firecrawl-redis on the firecrawl Docker network. RabbitMQ Uses firecrawl-rabbitmq on the firecrawl Docker network. PostgreSQL Uses firecrawl-postgres on the firecrawl Docker network. Playwright Uses firecrawl-playwright on the firecrawl Docker network for browser-based scraping. Worker Ports 3004 is used by the extract worker and 3005 is used by the queue worker. These ports are internal to the container and do not need to be exposed on the host.
